prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for Eterno Retorno. Original post-apocalyptic civilian resistance world. AMERICAN ACTION COMIC, late 1990s arcade fighting-game illustration. Bold confident BLACK INK contours, clean angular silhouettes, rich FLAT vibrant colors, large HARD-EDGED cel-shaded shadows, bold printed halftone. Deep ink black and aubergine, vivid teal/cyan electronics, rusty orange and violet clothing, warm natural skin. NOT pencil sketchbook, NOT grayscale, NO dense scratchy crosshatching, NO photorealism, NO 3D, NO pixel art. Ordinary people with patched civilian clothes and improvised tools fight autonomous machines. NO medieval armor, swords, cloaks, runes, magic staffs, skeletons, goblins or monsters. No franchise characters, logos or superhero costumes. No text or UI baked in unless explicitly required. Protagonist design MUST match the reference exactly: Mauro,30,lean human man with messy dark brown hair, slight stubble, entire expressive human face visible, NO MASK or respirator, NO hood covering head. Pharmacist. Teal patched field jacket with rolled sleeves, aubergine shoulder medical satchel, faded black jeans, ordinary boots, bottle vials. Holds two short improvised utility knives, a green acid vial secured at belt. No assassin armor. Quick nervous civilian, focused expression. ONE frozen COMIC foreground closeup, bracing defensively against a strike from the RIGHT, blocking with the same weapon or shield. Fierce furious expression, brows down, teeth clenched or battle cry. Face, torso, arms and improvised tool large and clear. Thin white silhouette outline around body AND weapon. Landscape1536x1024, clear margins, TRUE transparent background. No sprite sheet, no multiple poses. Colored lights and sparks limited to a few isolated marks; game animates effects behind.
NEW FINAL ART DIRECTION: original printed American action COMIC BOOK, this is a full REDRAW of the illustration. Strong expressive black ink outlines, angular purposeful shapes, two-tone cel shadows, vivid controlled hero accents on a dark violet/steel/petrol palette, visible Ben-Day halftone clusters and occasional dry ink. A clear THIN WHITE PAPER CUTOUT border around every person, machine, standalone object and icon silhouette. Comics cut-paper aesthetic, NOT 3D, NOT realistic painting, NOT pixel art, NOT generic airbrushed fantasy. Civilian survivors versus autonomous killing machines; retain their identities, jobs, workwear and improvised tools. No superhero costumes. The illustration must visibly feel like hand-inked printed comic art. True transparent alpha behind the entire cutout and ALL gutters; no solid rectangular backdrops, no opaque panels. White silhouette contour, selective speed hatching and small isolated comic spark accents only, all within canvas.
